_help: Quiz is OFF (no friend entries), so letters open straight away. To turn it on for a friend, add an entry like "jathin": { "question": "...", "options": ["a", "b", "c"], "answer": 0, "correct_line": "...", "wrong_line": "..." }. options: 3 or 4 choices; answer: the index of the right one (0 = first). Options are shuffled on screen. score_lines: shown with the score at the finale (perfect = all right, good = at least half, low = fewer).

score_lines.perfect: [PLACEHOLDER] A perfect score! You know every one of us by heart.
score_lines.good: [PLACEHOLDER] Pretty great! You know us better than we know ourselves.
score_lines.low: [PLACEHOLDER] Haha, looks like we owe you more canteen trips together!
